blockingFindings.title: PID reuse regression is not deterministically covered
blockingFindings.issue: The R3 test flips `reused` in `setTimeout(() => { reused = true; }, 1)` after queuing the child `close` event in a microtask. `_settleTimeout()` runs from the close microtask and collects `unterminatedMembers` before the timer is expected to run, so the test can pass without exercising the reused-start-fingerprint path required by R3.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In the R3 test's `onSignal` branch for `SIGKILL`, set `reused = true` before emitting `close`, or delay the close event until after the fixture returns the reused stat, so `_collectUnterminatedPosixMembers()` observes the changed `startFingerprint`.
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires automated coverage for PID reuse behavior. Because the test normally settles before the reused fingerprint is visible, it does not reliably cover the mandatory acceptance requirement.
